observations.note: The band enters with moderate impact but lacks a massive dynamic shift.
Drum intensity increases here, creating a noticeable but contained energy peak.
The sitar cuts through but competes with the mid-range of the distorted guitars.
With the band dropped out, the sitar becomes perfectly clear.
The rhythm guitars are adequately distorted but lack deep low-end resonance.
The returning riff sounds competent though slightly digital.
The rhythm section holds a steady but somewhat mechanical pocket.
Faster drum patterns drive the song forward adequately.
The sudden dropout to the solo sitar sounds like a harsh splice.
The track ends abruptly instead of naturally fading.
Blending doom instrumentation with Darbari scales creates an appropriately dark atmosphere.

overall_note: A reasonably dark fusion track with a steady pulse. The arrangement works conceptually, though the production sounds somewhat boxy and features abrupt editing transitions.
